newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Koc Hldg 97 H1 profit up 73.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Turk Koc Hldg 97 H1 profit up 73.3 pct.

text.p: ISTANBUL, 30 JULY (REUTER) - Jan-June 1997 final (billion lira unless stated)

NOTE- Koc Holding A.S is the parent company of Turkey's leading industrial conglomerate and decided on July 29 to raise its paid-in capital to 10.68 trillion lira from the current 10 trillion lira after the merger of Koc Yatirim into Koc Holding. Koc Yatirim shareholders, except Koc Holding, will receive a 1.28288 Koc Holding share in return for each 1,000 lira nominal-valued Koc Yatirim share.
The figures above do not take into account Turkey's 78 consumer price inlation in june.
